U.note: Clean dark calculator with a 12-digit cap, shows the last expression, labelled keys, live region, good keyboard handling and a clear Error state; slightly small keys on desktop.

V.note: Charming retro LCD design, but the history panel and extra backspace bar overbuild a basic calculator, and the Escape handler contains odd leftover code.

W.note: Solid iOS-style calculator with repeat-equals and percent; equals styled identically to the operators, error message is just Error, and the 15-digit cap overflows the display.

X.note: Polished light calculator with strong hierarchy, thousands separators, repeat-equals, a readable 'Cannot divide by zero' message, labelled keys and screen-reader status; the display shrinks the 12-digit number to fit.

Y.note: Compact and correct with a clear error message, but the operator keys have no aria labels and the display has no status role; the dark palette is fine but plain.

Z.note: A seven-segment pocket calculator with a distinctive look and a screen-reader live region; limited to 9 digits and larger results turn to Error, and the SVG display code adds weight.
